newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land trade halted pending statement.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land trade halted pending statement.

text.p: Trading in shares in property firm DBS Land were suspended on Tuesday morning, dealers said.
An official at the Stock Exchange of Singapore told Reuters the shares were suspended at the request of DBS Land pending an announcement.
Market sources said they expected an announcement regarding a placement of new shares by DBS Land.
The market is expecting DBS Land to raise its stake in healthcare group Parkway Holdings after taking a Singapore $391 million 19.2 percent holding in the firm in May.
Han Cheng Fong, deputy chairman and group chief executive officer of DBS Land, told analysts last week the firm was interested in buying more Parkway shares.
DBS Land shares closed at S$5.00 on Monday. Parkway shares were unchanged at S$6.90 at 0145 GMT on Tuesday.
